title: Resolution Half-Life by Goal Type
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:outcome resolution_type=goal
| stats avg(days_to_resolution) as avg_days, count as outcomes by goal_type
| sort - avg_days
description: Measures how long predictions tied to different goal types typically take to resolve.
value: Resolution half-life helps choose forecast horizons that match the pace of each life domain.
implementation: Store `days_to_resolution` on resolved forecasts and compare average resolution time by goal type.
visualization: Table of goal types with average days to resolution.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how long different kinds of goals usually take before your predictions about them can be judged.
